{{Top}}
A '''holodrama''', also known as a '''holofilm''' or '''holomovie''', was a form of fiction entertainment created using [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] technology. As the name implied, the purpose of a holodrama was to present a dramatic story, rather than to document an actual event or present comedic scenarios. Creators of a holodrama would record their work onto a disk, which could be transmitted physically or via remote by way of a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]].
